title: Supply on Hand from the Latest Specialty Shipment, Formulary Benefit Transition Fills
content:
**Deduction.** Under the Formulary Benefit, supply still on hand from the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug is deducted from a specialty transition supply. The days of that fill not yet elapsed on the handling date are its days supply less the days from its ship date to the handling date, and never less than zero. How much is deducted depends on where the fill was delivered:

- **Delivered to the member's home:** all the days not yet elapsed are deducted.
- **Delivered to the prescriber's office:** only the whole dose cycles still on hand are deducted. That is the days not yet elapsed divided by the length of one dose cycle, rounded down to a whole number, and multiplied by that length. One dose cycle is the fill's days supply divided by its quantity.
- **Any other delivery location:** nothing is deducted.

The deduction is taken off the supply's days. Only after that is the supply held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill and taken in whole days.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical fill: 28 days, quantity 2, so one dose cycle is 14 days)

| Days from ship date to handling date | Days not yet elapsed | Home delivery: deducted | Prescriber's office: deducted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 18 | 18 | 14 (one whole cycle) |
| 20 | 8 | 8 | 0 (no whole cycle) |
| 28 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 35 | 0 (never less than zero) | 0 | 0 |
